youtube.title: The 3 Follow-Ups That Finish Any AI Draft
youtube.description:

youtube.title: The One Line That Stops AI Inventing Numbers #shorts
youtube.description:
AI will invent a number and sound completely certain about it. Add this to your prompt: "Don't invent numbers, names or dates. If you need one, write [NEED: what] and I'll fill it in." Now it asks instead of guessing.

youtube.title: Why AI Misses The Middle Of What You Paste
youtube.description:
A long paste gets read best at the start and the end, so your question belongs underneath the document, not above it.

Free: 12 work prompts that actually work (PDF) -> https://kelvorixdigital.lemonsqueezy.com/checkout/buy/2a95cbaf-fd7e-4e28-908e-ccf98199c508?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=middle-of-document

0:00 The problem (and the study behind it)
0:32 Fix one: the question goes underneath
0:44 Fix two: say it twice
0:55 Fix three: make it prove it
1:05 Move the question to the bottom

Source: Liu et al., "Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts", Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics, 2024 (arXiv:2307.03172). Accuracy was highest when the relevant information sat at the beginning or the end of the input context, and degraded significantly when the model had to use information in the middle.
